remarks: Enjoy this delightful 2 bedroom 1 bath condo in a very well maintained building with close proximity to downtown. It is on the first floor with no need for elevators or stairs. Can get into your home from the outside and not even go into the building except for the mail. In the basement is the laundry room, community room, locked storage unit and a fitness room. The HOA include heat/hot water, gas cooking, sewer, snow removal, basic cable, internet, 24/7 security at the entrance to the parking. 1 outdoor parking space comes with the condo and you can purchase additional spaces. In ground pool-seasonal. Property management is onsite for any questions. Close to downtown for the restaurants, pubs, movie theaters, library, shopping, the Tully Medical Center, Metro North/Amtrak is about 1.3 miles away and the bus stop is across the street. This is a great opportunity to be so close to everything and enjoy all the amenities Stamford has to offer. Don't delay and schedule your visit.
